description: Variant-admission receipt for registry-bound finance forecast generator comparisons.
purpose: This contract defines the shadow-only gate that compares a candidate finance forecast generator variant against the registered baseline before any optimizer or calculator mutation can be requested.

variant_gate_id.constraint: Stable receipt id for this paired comparison.

baseline_variant_id.constraint: Known generator variant id, usually calculator:calculator.6:default.

candidate_variant_id.constraint: Known registry variant id being compared against baseline.

experiment_refs.constraint: Historical replay experiment ids used by the comparison.

embargo_days.constraint: Embargo evidence copied from historical replay.

executable.constraint: Must be true for any admitted_shadow_variant decision.

paired_claim_count.constraint: Number of matched resolved scorecards joined by event contract.

excluded_split_count.constraint: Paired event rows excluded from admission statistics because split membership is purged, embargoed, or otherwise excluded.

missing_split_membership_count.constraint: Paired event rows whose replay scorecards did not carry executable split_membership binding.

key_authority.constraint: Exactly tools/finance/event_keys.py. The receipt must pair on the shared event-key primitive, not a local fallback hash recipe.

paired_by.constraint: Must be comparison_event_key. Forecast/truth identity fields are audit-only.

identity_decoupled_pair_count.constraint: Pairs where forecast_id, candidate_ref, or truth_join_key differ but comparison_event_key matches.

excluded_from_variant_comparison.constraint: Counts candidate_smoke_test, missing comparison key, missing loss, and other explicitly excluded scorecards.

mismatch_reasons.constraint: Best-effort event-contract mismatch counts for unpaired candidate scorecards.

mean_loss_delta.constraint: candidate minus baseline; negative means lower candidate loss.

loss_delta_std.constraint: Sample standard deviation of paired candidate-minus-baseline loss differentials when at least two pairs exist.

loss_delta_std_error.constraint: Standard error of the paired loss differential mean when computable.

paired_sample_size.constraint: Number of paired losses used for statistics.

paired_losses.constraint: Pair audit rows joined by comparison_event_key, not row order. Statistical interpretation must use loss_differential_series.

loss_differential_series.constraint: Paired loss rows ordered by subject/event time and keyed by comparison_event_key.

dependence_diagnostics.constraint: Must include event-window overlap counts, selected lag, variance estimator, and split_binding diagnostics with bound_row_count, missing_split_membership_count, excluded_split_count, purged_pair_count, embargoed_pair_count, and usable_pair_count before any DM-style statistic is interpreted.

selected_lag.constraint: Lag used for HAC/Bartlett long-run variance estimation.

event_window_overlap_count.constraint: Number of pairwise event-window overlaps in the loss-differential series.

diebold_mariano.constraint: Minimum-sample-gated paired-loss statistic block using explicit variance-estimator metadata. Status may be not_computed_minimum_sample, not_computed_zero_variance, not_requested, or computed_hac_normal_approximation.

hln_small_sample_correction.constraint: Reserved Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction block; v4.2 does not apply it.

finance_model_selection_receipt_reserved.purpose: v5 statistical admission layer for multiple registry-bound variants after comparison_event_key pairing is invariant.

reason.constraint: Examples: insufficient_paired_sample, non_executable_split_policy, split_membership_unbound, paired_loss_improved_shadow_only, candidate_not_better_than_baseline.
